name: Granite Knuckles
desc: +1 Rock segment in fights. Rock wins add +1d4.

name: Iron Gauntlet
desc: +1 Might (bigger Power Dice).

name: Ember Brand
desc: Your Flame wins apply 2 Burn.

name: Dealer's Glove
desc: +1 Loaded segment (your largest type) in fights.

name: Shears of the Guild
desc: Your Edges also count as Loaded. +1 Edge segment in fights.

name: Bureau Stamp
desc: At fight start, delete one segment of the enemy's largest type.

name: Tidewater Locket
desc: Ties heal you 5 HP.

name: Bramble Charm
desc: +1 Rock Thorn segment in fights (reflect 50% when you lose on it). +5 max HP.

name: Siphon Fang
desc: +1 Siphon segment (your largest type) in fights.

name: Weighted Coin
desc: Luck +3 (15% to re-spin a loss). Every re-spin adds a Blank to your wheel this fight.

name: Mask of the House
desc: +1 Mirror segment in fights. Your Mirrors become Wild when the Pot is 8x or more.

name: Opal Pendant
desc: +1 Wild segment in fights.

name: Clerk's Monocle
desc: +2 Insight (reveals fog). Start fights with 1 Ink on the enemy.

name: Lucky Pebble
desc: +1 Luck (5% to re-spin a loss).

name: Inkwell
desc: Start each fight with 2 Ink on the enemy.

name: Whetstone
desc: Your first win each fight is a critical hit.

name: Ember Jar
desc: Burn you apply decays every 2 turns instead of every turn.

name: Driftwood
desc: +8 max HP.

name: Loaded Die
desc: Your Power Dice never roll below 2.

name: Grip Tape
desc: +1 Grip each turn.

name: Steel Nerve
desc: +1 Nerve: every tie adds an extra +0.5x to the Pot.

name: Tide Salt
desc: Start each fight with 4 Flow.
